name: EverLoyalty ~Eien no Chuusei~
source:
The main character, Yulice, leaves for the capital in order to enter the service to his majesty. He buys a very strong horse, Kayana and enters the qualifying period. Here he has two likable teachers: Jill and Rian.

[From YaoiOtaku]
translation:
主角尤丽丝前往首都，为国王陛下效力。他买了一匹非常强壮的马卡亚纳（Kayana）并进入资格赛阶段。在这里，他有两位可爱的老师：吉尔和瑞安。

[来自八追宅男]
